title_en: Chess Games: More Than Universal Atoms
title_zh: 国际象棋棋局多于宇宙原子
reveal_en: The number of distinct possible ways a game of chess can unfold vastly exceeds the estimated number of atoms in the observable universe. This staggering figure highlights the immense complexity that can arise from simple rules.
reveal_zh: 国际象棋的可能走法数量，远超可观测宇宙中的原子总数。这个惊人的数字揭示了简单规则也能产生无限复杂性。
meaning_en: It shows how exponential growth and combinatorial possibilities can quickly lead to incomprehensible scales, even from simple initial conditions.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了指数增长和组合可能性如何从简单初始条件中创造出难以想象的尺度。

visual.motion: Expanding grid lines forming complex patterns, fading into a starry expanse.
